title: Grateful Dead Live at Henry J Kaiser Convention Center on 1987-03-02
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > R8Brain > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 03/2016
source: AUD: Unknown mics & lead deck > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-Metal 90's. Recording by Jon Bernstein.

ai_review.summary: Fans are grateful for the release of this first “Morning Dew” show after the coma, though they haven’t heard it yet.
ai_review.review: The lone reviewer expresses enthusiastic thanks that an audio version finally exists for what is described as the first Morning Dew concert after the coma. No comments are made about the performance or recording quality because the reviewer has not listened to the tape.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one brief, positive review with a 4‑star rating and no substantive details on music or sound quality; rating reflects reviewer enthusiasm but limited information.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No technical comments; reviewer has not yet listened to the recording.
